ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~5%) to low-intensity pixels (~95%) across the ventral surface, with high-intensity pixels restricted to localized marks and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black contiguous field across 95% of the fluke area. High-intensity white pixels are distributed in linear patterns across both lobes and concentrated in high-density clusters at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~1:4 relative to the notch opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the primary trailing edge; amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips due to irregular surface accretions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, curving from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters with roughly circular geometry localized at the distal tips and scattered sporadically as small dots across the medial lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of high-contrast, multi-directional linear pixel streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths, most prominent on the right lobe and inner regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of irregular, high-contrast structural accretions (barnacles) at both distal tips; extensive rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct secondary indentation/notch located on the interior left edge of the primary central notch.
